note: Same bound up to the heuristic substitution `Σ(log p)² ≈ (W/2) log W`; the gain is `log R` with `R² ≈ (x/|δq|)/(q+x/4W)` (R capped at `W'`) rather than `log(W/|δ|q)`, and the factor is `φ(q)/q` times `log R` on the left.

theorem prop_5_2_4_c {α x δ U' W' W : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ)) (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) (hx : 0 < x) (hW : 0 < W)
    (hδ0 : δ ≠ 0) (hcond : x / (4 * W) + q ≤ x / (|δ| * q)) (hU' : x / (2 * W) ≤ U')
    (hW' : 0 ≤ W') :
    (S2 α x U' W' W ≤ (W - W' + x / (|δ| * q)) * logSqSum W' W) ∧
    (∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → R ≤ W' → R ^ 2 ≤ x / (|δ| * q) / (q + x / (4 * W)) →
      Nat.totient q / q * Real.log R * S2 α x U' W' W ≤
        (W - W' + x / (|δ| * q)) * logSqSum W' W) := by

proof_context.conclusion: If `x/4W + q ≤ x/|δ|q`: `S₂ ≤ (W-W'+x/|δ|q) Σ (log p)²`, and `(φ(q)/q) log R · S₂ ≤ (W-W'+x/|δ|q) Σ (log p)²` for `1 ≤ R ≤ W'`, `R² ≤ (x/|δq|)/(q+x/4W)`.
